title: Use only qualified hairdressers
what: Have hairdressing done for fee or reward only by qualified hairdressers.

sources.title: Hairdressers Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An individual must not act as a hairdresser for fee, gain or reward unless the individual is qualified to act as a hairdresser

administration.who: Authorised officers (Fair Trading Act investigators and others, NSW)
